maria: Morning—quick async standup.

maria: What I did: landed kernel slot-prefetch patch on canary (PR #482), ran microbench against seq-len=512 workloads.

maria: Blockers: seeing ~3-4% p95 regression on one shard, likely KV eviction during warmups.

maria: Today: triage logs, add more metrics around slot-stealing, post a small hotfix if needed.

raj: Nice. Can you paste the bench output? Also pinged me on PR review.

ellie: Looked at logs — TTLs look ok but eviction spikes align with GC pauses. I can repro locally with --evict-threshold=0.6.

sam: @maria want me to revert canary if it's impacting prod? current canary QPS hasn't tripped SLOs.

maria: Not yet — only at 5% canary. Sharing perf snippet:
```
Benchmark results (canary vs baseline)
baseline p95: 38ms
canary p95: 40.2ms (+5.5%)
throughput: stable
```

lee: Looks like KV miss rate + small latency bump. Suggest we enable prefix caching for the affected route. I'll push a config change.

oncall-bot: deploy check: no alerts in last 30m; p95 drift detected on shard-7.

raj: @lee can you post the config diff? Also requesting infra to increase canary sample to 10% to stress.

ellie: Repro steps for local:
`./bench --model=redwood-base --seq=512 --concurrency=8 --evict=0.6`

sam: Code review note: PR #488 depends on #482. @maria can you add a test for slot drop? Small nits inline.

maria: Will add the test today. Blocking: need infra creds to run long warmup harness; @raj can you grant?

raj: Done — shared creds in 1Password path ai/bench/creds.

lee: Pushed config change to canary route: `enable_prefix_cache: true` — watching.

maria: Thanks. Plan:
1) triage logs
2) add test
3) run 2h warmup harness
4) re-evaluate canary; if p95 still + we'll revert.

sam: ack :thumbsup:

ellie: If you need quick heap traces I can attach them after harness run.

maria: That'd be helpful, thanks.

raj: I'll bump canary to 10% midway through the harness; will monitor SLOs.

lee: watching metrics now — will post p95 time series in a bit.

oncall-bot: scheduled task: long-warmup-harness started by raj at 6301234700.

maria: End of thread — will DM updates, thanks team.
